entities.summary: Anna Pujol Puigvehí. Historian, professor and archaeologist. Bachelor of Arts from the University of Barcelona (1970), with the thesis “The Indiketes as the literary and archaeological sources”, Dr. summa cum laude in History from the Autonomous University of Barcelona with the doctoral thesis on the “Pre-Roman Population of the Northeast of the Iberian Peninsula. Genesis and development of Iberian culture in the Girona and south of France lands” (1981). She has taught at the Autonomous University of Barcelona for over 15 years, and has been Associate professor of Archaeology and Ancient History of the UOC.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent archaeologist and historian, Anna Pujol i Puigvehí's work has contributed significantly to our understanding of Iberian culture and its development in the Northeast of the Iberian Peninsula. Her research has shed light on the pre-Roman population and their legacy in the region.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a renowned archaeologist and historian, Anna Pujol i Puigvehí's work has significantly contributed to our understanding of the Pre-Roman Population of the Northeast Iberian Peninsula. Her research has shed light on the Genesis and development of Iberian culture in the Girona and south of France lands.
